name: BRASS
summary: An experiment applying broadband radio-astronomy receivers to dark-photon and axion searches; BRASS-p is the prototype phase.
detection_principle: A conducting surface converts dark photons to electromagnetic waves, which are focused and measured with heterodyne radio-frequency receivers; axion operation requires a magnetized conversion surface.

collaboration.participants_note: Only documented principal institutions are listed; full author and affiliation lists are in the sources. Collaborating-institution addresses are not substituted for detector locations.

results.summary: Initial dark-photon searches constrain kinetic mixing; magnetized axion-conversion surfaces are under subsequent development.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
